blocks.md: An establishment-level panel built by the US Census Bureau from its business register.

- Virtually every establishment with paid employees in the US nonfarm private economy.
- Annual employment, payroll and major industry, with establishments linked over time and to their parent firms.

blocks.title: Beyond the lecture
blocks.md: The LBD starts in 1976 and is available only to approved projects in Federal Statistical Research Data Centers; published results are rounded for disclosure avoidance (e.g. observation counts rounded to the nearest thousand).

| Good for | Weak for |
| --- | --- |
| Industry and firm employment, near-universal coverage | Worker characteristics (none) |
| Entry, exit and job reallocation | Output, prices and trade (needs linking to other files) |
| Long consistent annual panel | Open access |
